final: WITH s2 AS (SELECT SUM(traitcount) AS tot FROM scanfeatures), s3 AS (SELECT f.zoneref AS z, f.traitcount AS tc, CASE WHEN s2.tot = 0 THEN NULL ELSE f.traitcount * 1.0 / s2.tot END AS ratio FROM scanfeatures f JOIN s2 ON s2.tot IS NOT NULL), s4 AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS av FROM s3) SELECT s3.z, s3.tc, s3.ratio, s3.ratio - s4.av AS diff FROM s3 JOIN s4 ON s4.av IS NOT NULL WHERE s3.ratio > s4.av ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 10
